task.description: WF-02, step 04b — fix the code of the server starter by the remarks of the first pass of the gates (REVIEWER FAIL, SECURITY-REVIEWER PASS with Lows). Fix in tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js: (1) M1 of REVIEWER = F3 of SECURITY-REVIEWER: a readyPattern whose one capture group does not take part in the match (for example an optional group) must not end in a raw TypeError and must not leave the stand alive: record the outcome of the start in an explicit field, send every match through the loopback check (a match whose group took no text is refused with URL_REFUSED, the kit's code for a link that is not a loopback link) and every failure through the same clean-up as the other start failures (group killed, registration and marker removed), so that every path throws the kit's error class; (2) L1: listen for the child's error event before the pipes are touched, in the order runner.js uses; (3) L2: in withStand, when the stop error is the same object as the body error (the body itself awaited a failing stop()), add nothing; (4) I4 of SECURITY-REVIEWER: in withStand, a body error that cannot take a property (a frozen object, or not an object) is rethrown unchanged, never replaced by a TypeError of the assignment; (5) L3: an env value with a NUL is refused with a message that says 'without NUL', as the message for args does; (6) F1 of SECURITY-REVIEWER: the comment that says a server never sees the home folder is false — say the truth (the child gets no HOME variable; Node can still find the home folder through the system's list of users; decisions/0109 O15). In tools/README.md, the starter paragraph: (7) L4: add that a server that ended by itself before stop() fails whatever its exit code (decisions/0109 O14); (8) F1: the same truth about the home folder. In the README keep every existing word of the paragraph (section 10 of the design and the tests E2K-41, E2K-60 and E2S-19 read it): add clauses, do not remove or reword the existing ones; run prettier on README.md. Not in this step: F2 (state folders bound to env) and the HOME default go to the design of REQ-106 (O15); F4 and the browser.js shapes are defects at step 10 (O16). Prove each fix outside the project with a trial that fails on the code of step 02b and passes on yours (the trials of the reviewers in the session scratchpad may be reused); then from tools/: npm run -s format:check, npm run -s lint, npm run -s traces | tail -1, npm run -s handoffs-check | tail -1, node --test test/e2e-kit.test.js | tail -8 (still only E2K-50 red, until TEST-DESIGNER), and the real picker through the starter (check (a) of section 14). No sleeps; waits for facts with limits. Task text and files hold no absolute machine paths and no names of the owner's other projects. Do not edit any test file; do not commit or push.

result.summary: WF-02 step 04b, the rework for the FAIL of step 04 (REVIEWER: M1 blocking, L1-L4) together with SECURITY-REVIEWER F1, F3 (= M1) and I4; next comes pass 2 of 3 of SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER. All eight items of the task are closed, in the two files of the write set and nothing else (index.js, fake-stand.js, every test file, every other kit file and tools/src are byte for byte as before). tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js: (1) M1/F3 - the outcome of the start is recorded in an explicit field kind (link, error, timeout, exited) and the link travels as text; every match goes through assertLoopbackUrl, so a match whose group took no part (an optional group, or a group in the other alternative) is refused with URL_REFUSED in the kit's words, and goes through abortStart like every other start failure (SIGKILL to the group, the wait until it is gone, unregisterGroup, the marker removed); no path of startStand throws a TypeError any more. (2) L1 - the child's error listener is attached before the pipes are touched and the pipes are read with ?. (the order of runner.js); a spawn that fails with EMFILE now gives STAND_START_FAILED 'could not start "<name>": EMFILE' at once, the start timer cleared, the marker removed, and the spec process goes on instead of crashing; the registration block right after spawn (C-2) is unchanged. (4) I4 - the assignment of cleanupError sits in try/catch, so a frozen or sealed body error, or one with a read-only cleanupError, is rethrown unchanged; a value that is not an object is still skipped; a thrown string, undefined and null are rethrown as they are. (5) L3 - 'env value of <name> must be a string without NUL', the words of the args message; the value stays out. (6) F1 - the comment above baseEnvironment() says the truth: no HOME variable, the home folder itself is not hidden, Node finds it through the system's list of users (decisions/0109 O15). tools/README.md, the starter paragraph (line 844) only, two clauses inserted and no existing word removed or reworded (118 of 118 words kept in order, 45 added; no other line changed; prettier left the file unchanged): (7) L4 - 'requires the exit code 0 after that signal; if the server ended by itself before `stop()`, `stop()` fails whatever the exit code (decisions/0109)'; (8) F1 - 'nothing else (no `HOME` unless the spec gives it; the home folder itself is not hidden: Node finds it through the system's list of users, decisions/0109)'.
